prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. Animals in pairs, two camels, two oxen, two deer, stand in a calm line on a plain earthen ramp leading up to the wide wooden door open in the side of the vast ark, its whole hull smeared pitch-black under a flat plank roof, onlookers in silhouette seen from behind on a ridge in the foreground. Morning, soft grey light and dust. Strange and orderly. The ark is one long, low, box-shaped wooden hull with straight sides of rough planks and flat square ends, the same low height from end to end. The ark has no mast, sail, prow, figurehead, funnel or smokestack, no smoke rising from it and no band along its waterline. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the great wooden ark, the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
